why: The office floor's palette, and only the floor's. The tokens block is byte-identical to palette.json — the --np-cb-* tokens, so the chrome still cannot drift — but the ramp is lifted out of src/assets/characters/crew-atlas.png itself, so a plate and the character standing on it are drawn from one box of crayons. Kept separate from palette.json rather than replacing its ramp, because the title and tier key art is a dark register and re-rendering it against these warm steps would silently restyle it.
